rules: Only these components and tokens below the hero; no hex colours; one filled Button per view; design empty, working, done and error states; check light and dark.

components.name: Button
components.use: variant = default (filled) · secondary · outline · ghost · destructive · outline-destructive · link; size = sm · default · lg · icon · icon-sm.

components.name: DropdownMenu
components.use: row actions, sort, and filters.

components.name: Tabs
components.use: a segmented control for switching what a list shows (Sounds, MIDI, Other).

components.name: Input
components.use: one field look: bg-field, a hairline border-input, shadow-xs, a stronger border on hover, the ink ring on focus.

components.name: Textarea
components.use: one field look: bg-field, a hairline border-input, shadow-xs, a stronger border on hover, the ink ring on focus.

components.name: Combobox
components.use: one field look: bg-field, a hairline border-input, shadow-xs, a stronger border on hover, the ink ring on focus.

components.name: InputOTP
components.use: one field look: bg-field, a hairline border-input, shadow-xs, a stronger border on hover, the ink ring on focus.

components.name: SearchField
components.props: value, onChange, label, placeholder, size, className
components.use: search in a toolbar.

components.name: Checkbox
components.use: as named.

components.name: Switch
components.use: as named.

components.name: Slider
components.use: as named.

components.name: FolderField
components.props: value, onValueChange, onBrowse, placeholder, disabled, browseLabel, className
components.use: as named.

components.name: PageHeader
components.use: every page.

components.name: PageSection
components.use: a titled part of a page, with at most one action (usually "See all").

components.name: Card
components.use: a raised surface for a group of related things.

components.name: Separator
components.use: between groups in a menu or a toolbar.

components.name: IconTile
components.use: an icon on a plate (empty states, step lists, settings hubs).

components.name: EmptyState
components.props: icon, title, description, actions, pixel, className, children, ...props
components.use: what will appear here, and the first step (at most two actions).

components.name: Callout
components.props: tone, icon, title, actions, className, children, ...props
components.use: a message inside the page.

components.name: Skeleton
components.use: loading, in the shape of the final layout.

components.name: Spinner
components.use: inside a button that is working ("Installing…"), or a one-line status.

components.name: Progress
components.use: a job with a known size (value) or not (indeterminate).

components.name: Badge
components.use: a short status in a row or card (tone).

components.name: Toaster
components.use: bottom-right, one line, one optional action (usually Undo).

components.name: Kbd
components.use: a key in a hint or a menu.

components.name: ListSummary
components.use: a list's closing line, "Showing 3 of 40 sounds".

components.name: Waveform
components.use: the Library outside the desktop (cloud web, app pages).

components.name: LibraryDialog
components.use: the Library outside the desktop (cloud web, app pages).

components.name: Dropzone
components.props: title, description, dragging, disabled, multiple, onChoose, extra, className
components.use: the Library outside the desktop (cloud web, app pages).

components.name: ActionForm
components.use: generated app UIs.

components.name: AppHero
components.props: icon, wordmark, description, art, accent, className
components.use: generated app UIs.
